'''Trauma''' was an [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he fought alongside the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Knox/Legends|Knox]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron's]] [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]]. Although the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces were holding their ground, the sudden appearance of [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] immediately turned the tide of the battle: The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] began slaughtering every ARF trooper who lay in his path. Trauma and the others including the Jedi were slaughtered by Opress causing the Republic defeat on Devaron.

==Biography==
[[File:BattleAtTempleOfEedit-Monster.png|thumb|left|250px|Trauma and his ARF troopers charging at Savage Opress.]]
Trauma was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]]<ref name="MonsterGuide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep313|text="Monster" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. At some point, Trauma became a [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force trooper]]<ref name="Monster" /> and also became a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]].<ref name="MonsterGuide" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> .Trauma was deployed to defend the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] .Unfortunately Trauma was in a republic Consular-class when it was shot down by droid artillery and were force to retreat back to the temple,along with his [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]],<ref name="Monster" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Magazine">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 4|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine'' 4]]</ref><ref name="Comic">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.19|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.19]]</ref> [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]]<ref name="MonsterGuide" /> and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]],<ref name="Clone Card: Halsey">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_halsey.jpg|text=Clone Card: Halsey}}</ref> [[Knox/Legends|Knox]].<ref name="MonsterGuide" /> Trauma and the others were able to hold back the Separatist forces and held the upper hand in the battle. However, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] sent his new apprentice [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] to finish the battle and destroy the Republic forces. Upon arriving on Devaron, Opress began mercilessly slaughtering all the ARF troopers. Trauma, witnessing this, ordered all his troops to charge at Opress. Opress simply rampaged through the clone ranks, butchering all who got in his way. Even though he was shot in the stomach, the magic from the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] saved him. Trauma was about to shoot Opress when he was uppercut by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] and was thrown behind him, killing him. Ultimately, the two Jedi were also [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Opress,<ref name="Monster" /> and [[Devaron massacre/Legends|the battle]] was lost by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Trauma wielded a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] and two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]]. He wore ARF trooper gear, a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]], and a [[Kama/Legends|kama]]. His armor sported green and red markings. During the [[Devaron massacre/Legends|Battle at the Temple of Eedit]], he appeared to have his DC-15S's [[Stock/Legends|fold-able stock]] unfolded at the rear of his gun.<ref name="Monster" /><ref name="MonsterGuide" />
